column1: # Word budgets for command documents (issue #1669). One document per line:
# A command document is read in full by every run that invokes it. It holds the
# steps to execute; rationale and incident history belong in a linked reference.
# flow/auto.md: the owner's starting target was 10183 (#1669). The declared
# budget is 10410, argued from measurement and approved by the owner on PR
# #1681: trimmed to 10182, the document had lost or altered 21 instructions
# that no machine check could see (5 found by two counter-model review passes,
# 16 by an independent old-versus-new read). With every one restored, and
# after #1670 removed its mirror-commit steps, it measures 10402. Its fenced
# blocks alone - the commands and report templates - are about 2100 words.
# Every other number is an INTERIM CAP - the document's size when the gate landed - so nothing grows
# while it waits to be trimmed. Owner targets still owed (#1669): flow/register.md
# 8208, flow/wave.md 6954, flow/finish.md 1791. Lower a number when you trim;
# raising one needs a reason in the PR.
